class cccma_ppp.models.mlp_models.cVAE_MLPConfig(encoder_hidden_dims, latent_size, decoder_hidden_dims=None, condition_embedding_dims=None, condition_embedding_size=None, condition_dependant_latent=False, condemb_to_decoder=True, batch_normalization=False, dropout_rate=None, init_method='trunc_normal')[source]

Bases: cVAEmodelConfigABC

Configuration for MLP-based conditional variational autoencoder (cVAE).

Parameters:

  • encoder_hidden_dims (list) – Hidden layer sizes for encoder network.

  • latent_size (int) – Dimensionality of latent space.

  • decoder_hidden_dims (list) – Hidden layer sizes for decoder network.

  • condition_embedding_dims (list) – Hidden layer sizes for condition embedding network.

  • condition_embedding_size (int) – Output size of condition embedding.

  • condition_dependant_latent (bool) – Whether latent distribution depends on condition.

  • condemb_to_decoder (bool) – Whether to pass condition embedding to decoder.

  • batch_normalization (bool) – Whether to use batch normalization.

  • dropout_rate (float) – Dropout probability.

  • init_method (Literal['trunc_normal', 'xavier']) – Weight initialization method.
